affected_branches.unifieddb: authoritative causal-delta persistence and commit certificates
affected_branches.claygraph: differential projection from causal committed state
affected_branches.harness: fault/replay/property test obligations only; Harness remains method
affected_branches.agency: goal/reward updates become outcome-gated non-monotone deltas

no claim that activation or commit means truth
no Harness mutation under self.root authority
